label: D1 after an a2 choice that led rarely to S1, when the agent will choose a2 again (mid-episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1, almost exclusively when the previous trial was a2 with a rare transition to S1 (prev_common==0 covers ~100% of activations whose previous trial is in the window; essentially never after a1 or after common transitions). Most remaining misses are rel -3 D1 steps, where the previous trial falls outside the window, so the predicate cannot see it. The agent goes on to choose a2 again (stay), and the policy logit favours a2. Activity is confined to episode trials ~10-59 (none before trial 10 or after ~60), so it has an odd dependence on episode time. It fires after both rewarded and unrewarded rare outcomes, somewhat more after unrewarded ones, and is concentrated when S2 is the good state and the value lies in a narrow mid band (7.1-7.5). Precision is only ~0.45: many matching D1 steps stay below threshold. action==2 (the agent own upcoming choice) is legitimate; no unobservable variables are used.
